initial_state.tagline: A simulated food delivery app. Every restaurant, dasher and order here is invented; nothing is cooked and nothing is charged.

bayfront-pizza-margherita.title: Margherita, 14-inch - Bayfront Pizza Co.
bullets: San Marzano tomatoes, fior di latte, basil
bayfront-pizza-margherita.description: The house margherita from the wood oven on Bayfront Avenue. Sliced unless you say otherwise in the notes; the box has a vent so the crust stays crisp.

bayfront-pizza-sausage.title: Fennel sausage and broccolini, 14-inch - Bayfront Pizza Co.
bullets: House fennel sausage, broccolini, chilli, pecorino
bayfront-pizza-sausage.description: White pie with crumbled fennel sausage, charred broccolini and a shake of chilli. The one the staff order.

bayfront-pizza-garlic-knots.title: Garlic knots, 6 - Bayfront Pizza Co.
bayfront-pizza-garlic-knots.description: Six knots from the pizza dough, brushed with garlic butter and parmesan out of the oven. Marinara in a tub.

siam-corner-pad-thai.title: Pad thai with prawns - Siam Corner
bullets: Rice noodles, prawns, egg, bean sprouts, peanuts
Lime and chilli flakes on the side
siam-corner-pad-thai.description: Pad thai from the corner of Pike and Ninth, peanuts and lime packed separately so nothing goes soggy. Vegetarian version with tofu is the same price.

siam-corner-massaman.title: Massaman beef curry with jasmine rice - Siam Corner
bullets: Mild; ask for extra chilli in the notes
siam-corner-massaman.description: Slow-cooked massaman with potato and peanuts, rice in its own container. The mildest curry on the menu and the one most people order twice.

siam-corner-tom-kha.title: Tom kha gai soup, 24 oz - Siam Corner
siam-corner-tom-kha.description: Coconut chicken soup in a leak-proof 24 oz tub, with a small rice. The office sick-day order.

la-esquina-burrito.title: Carnitas burrito - La Esquina
bullets: Carnitas, rice, black beans, pico, crema, cheese
Salsa verde and roja on the side
la-esquina-burrito.description: Foil-wrapped carnitas burrito the size of a forearm from the Rivergate Boulevard taqueria. Add guacamole for $2.50 in the notes.

la-esquina-tacos.title: Street tacos, 4 (carne asada) - La Esquina
bullets: Four corn tortillas, carne asada, onion, cilantro
la-esquina-tacos.description: Four carne asada street tacos on doubled corn tortillas, with limes and pickled radish. Tortillas wrapped in foil, meat in a tub, assemble at the desk.

la-esquina-chips-guac.title: Chips and guacamole - La Esquina
la-esquina-chips-guac.description: A bag of chips fried that hour and an 8 oz tub of guacamole with lime and serrano. Enough for three people to argue over.

puget-burger-classic.title: Classic cheeseburger with fries - Puget Burger
bullets: Quarter-pound patty, cheddar, lettuce, tomato, house sauce
puget-burger-classic.description: A quarter-pound grass-fed patty on a brioche bun with skin-on fries. Fries are packed in a vented bag; they arrive better than most.

puget-burger-mushroom.title: Mushroom swiss burger with fries - Puget Burger
bullets: Sauteed mushrooms, swiss, caramelised onion, garlic aioli
puget-burger-mushroom.description: The same patty under a heap of sauteed mushrooms, swiss and caramelised onion, with garlic aioli. Substitute a portobello for a vegetarian version at no charge.

puget-burger-shake.title: Salted caramel milkshake, 16 oz - Puget Burger
bullets: Vanilla ice cream, salted caramel, whipped cream
puget-burger-shake.description: A thick shake that is still a shake after twenty-five minutes in an insulated bag. Comes with a spoon for the first five.

umi-sushi-platter.title: Nigiri and roll platter, 20 pieces - Umi Sushi
bullets: 8 nigiri (salmon, tuna, yellowtail, prawn), 12 roll pieces
umi-sushi-platter.description: The one-person platter from Umi on Third Avenue: eight nigiri and a California and spicy tuna roll, packed in a chilled bag with soy, ginger and wasabi.

umi-sushi-poke.title: Salmon poke bowl - Umi Sushi
bullets: Sushi rice, salmon, edamame, cucumber, avocado, ponzu
umi-sushi-poke.description: Salmon poke over sushi rice with edamame, cucumber and avocado; the ponzu and spicy mayo come in tubs so you dress it when it lands.

umi-sushi-miso.title: Miso soup and edamame - Umi Sushi
bullets: 12 oz miso with tofu and wakame
umi-sushi-miso.description: A 12 oz miso and a bowl of salted edamame. The add-on that turns a poke bowl into a meal.

marrow-creamery-pints.title: Two pints, choose your flavours - Marrow Point Creamery
bullets: Flavours in the notes: honey lavender, brown butter, sea salt chocolate, blackberry
marrow-creamery-pints.description: Two pints of small-batch ice cream from the creamery on Bayfront Avenue, packed with dry ice so they arrive scoopable, not soup. Name two flavours in the order notes.

quill-cafe-cookies.title: Half dozen brown butter chocolate chip cookies - Quill Cafe
bullets: Six large cookies, baked that morning
quill-cafe-cookies.description: Six big cookies from the cafe inside Quill & Kettle Books, baked before opening. Sold until they run out, usually mid-afternoon.

quill-cafe-carrot-cake.title: Carrot cake slice with cream cheese frosting - Quill Cafe
bullets: Generous slice, walnuts, cream cheese frosting
quill-cafe-carrot-cake.description: A thick slice of the cafe's carrot cake, with walnuts and a lot of frosting, in a clamshell with a fork.

ninth-pike-grocery-basics.title: Breakfast basics bundle: milk, eggs, bread, butter, bananas - Ninth & Pike Market
bullets: Half gallon 2%, dozen eggs, sourdough loaf, salted butter, 6 bananas
ninth-pike-grocery-basics.description: A shopper picks the bundle from the market on Pike Street and texts before substituting anything. Add items in the notes; they are charged at shelf price.

ninth-pike-grocery-produce.title: Weekly produce box, seasonal - Ninth & Pike Market
bullets: About 8 lb of what is good this week
Contents listed on the market's chalkboard each Monday
ninth-pike-grocery-produce.description: A box of whatever the market's produce buyer thinks is best that week, around eight pounds. In March that means citrus, chard, leeks, apples from storage and the first asparagus.

ninth-pike-grocery-coffee.title: Harborline Coffee whole bean, 12 oz, Bayfront Blend - Ninth & Pike Market
bullets: Medium roast, whole bean, roasted this week
Grind on request in the notes
ninth-pike-grocery-coffee.description: The Harborline house blend as sold at the market, roasted on Bayfront Avenue within the week. Ask for a grind in the notes and the shopper will run it through the market's grinder.

search_entries.title: Pizza delivery - DoorDash
search_entries.snippet: Bayfront Pizza Co.: margherita $19, fennel sausage and broccolini $23, garlic knots $7. Delivery fee $2.99, 30-40 min.

search_entries.title: Thai delivery - DoorDash
search_entries.snippet: Siam Corner on Pike and Ninth: pad thai, massaman and tom kha, delivery fee $1.99, 25-35 min.

search_entries.title: Grocery delivery from Ninth & Pike Market - DoorDash
search_entries.snippet: A breakfast basics bundle, a seasonal produce box and Harborline coffee beans, shopped and delivered in 40-60 minutes.

search_entries.title: Massaman beef curry - Siam Corner - $17.95
search_entries.snippet: Slow-cooked beef with potato and peanuts, jasmine rice packed separately. 4.7 stars from 300 ratings.

search_entries.title: Carnitas burrito - La Esquina - $13.50
search_entries.snippet: Forearm-sized carnitas burrito from the Rivergate Boulevard taqueria, 4.8 stars from 390 ratings, 20-30 minutes.

search_entries.title: Classic cheeseburger with fries - Puget Burger - $15.50
search_entries.snippet: Quarter-pound grass-fed patty, cheddar, house sauce, skin-on fries. 4.7 stars from 370 ratings.

search_entries.snippet: Eight nigiri and two rolls in a chilled bag. 4.8 stars from 320 ratings, 35-45 minutes.

search_entries.snippet: Small-batch ice cream packed with dry ice. Honey lavender, brown butter, sea salt chocolate or blackberry. 4.8 stars.
